source: William Lilly Christian Astrology original first edition 1647 Wellcome b30338724
heading: From whence, or from what Quarter the Native shall have his Wife
scope: Historical spouse birthplace and geographic distance assertions, with incompatible county/country target granularity and moral stereotypes; no real people validated.

groups.topic: Printed original CXXXIII spouse origin: heading and original county/country distinction

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: CHAP CXXXIII From whence or from what Quarter shall have Wife
claims.historical_only_meaning: A separate original numbered chapter after the number-of-wives study, asking source/distance of spouse rather than number or appearance
Lilly looks at the same marriage indicators but repurposes them to geographical origin, a different testable outcome
A marriage significator occupying ninth is one source alternative for predicting an unfamiliar-origin spouse
Occupancy of the third is a different alternative location condition, not simultaneously required with ninth
A peregrine marriage indicator is an alternative to house placement, with no fixed geographical metric supplied
Lilly describes absence of essential dignities alongside peregrine status, requiring a precise historical dignity assessment
The author concludes unfamiliar geographic spouse under those alternatives, unsupported by verified couples

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: not one borne in the County
claims.historical_only_meaning: Lilly explicitly predicts spouse birth outside same **county**, a narrower and different target than nationality or country
The author expressly corrects potential reading of country to county; this qualification is essential and falsifiable

groups.topic: Seventh lord in ninth or ninth lord in seventh, distance and favorable spouse character

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Lord of the seventh in ninth
claims.historical_only_meaning: Seventh house ruler residing in ninth is one alternate spouse-distance source condition

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: or Lord of ninth in seventh
claims.historical_only_meaning: Reverse rulership position is another alternative, not a conjunctive seventh-and-ninth rule

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: not borne neer his own Country or place of Birth
claims.historical_only_meaning: The claimed distance from natal birthplace is unspecific; its city/county/country reading differs from explicit first county clause
The original additionally associates this foreign-origin branch with wife's supposed religion or virtue; no person facts established
Wealth of a geographically unfamiliar spouse is a separate second outcome, not evidence for distance
A moral virtue characterization is a separate unsupported stereotype, not an empirical classification
The supposedly favorable spouse attributes are expressly stronger when the relevant significator is traditionally benefic
Additional essential accidental strength is named as co-condition for the favorable character claim

groups.topic: Venus ninth-house rulership in first/tenth and foreign birthplace

Venus ninth-ruler located in first house is one alternative position for another-country-spouse claim
Venus ninth-ruler in tenth is second alternative to Venus in first
Here the original uses **country** (unlike earlier county) to allege foreign-birth spouse; do not conflate the two criteria

claims.anchor_not_diplomatic: Wife no Native of place he was born in
